defs.def: the ruler of an empire 皇帝

ex.s: It's the seaside birds that deserve at least part of the blame for getting Nick Burchill blacklisted at the Fairmont Empress Hotel in Victoria, Canada.
ex.t: 尼克·伯奇尔被加拿大维多利亚的费尔蒙帝后大酒店列入黑名单，至少有一部分责任要归咎于海边的鸟。

ex.s: 63  (choose), but when he presented his masterpiece to the emperor’s chief minister, the old nan laughed.
ex.t: 63  （选择），但当他把他的杰作呈给皇帝的首席大臣时，这位老人笑了。

ex.s: In the case of emperors, the act required the person to touch their head to the ground.
ex.t: 在皇帝的情况下，该礼节要求人把头触地。

ex.s: The Chinese asked them to kowtow to the Qianlong Emperor.
ex.t: 那么，马卡特尼没有达成贸易协议就离开中国也就不足为奇了。

ex.s: Due to Han Gan’s natural talent and years of hard work, he was eventually chosen to serve Emperor Xuanzong in the royal palace.
ex.t: 由于韩干的天赋和多年努力，他最终被选中在皇宫为唐玄宗服务。

ex.s: Thinking on his feet, Lin started to tell a story about a cruel Roman emperor who tried to feed a man to wild animals.
ex.t: 林语堂灵机一动，开始讲一个故事，关于一位残忍的罗马皇帝试图把一个人喂给野兽。

ex.s: Qing emperors were very fond of clocks.
ex.t: 清朝皇帝非常喜欢钟表。

ex.s: Therefore, in order to please them, foreign envoys presented these emperors with the most intricate and splendid timepieces.
ex.t: 因此，为了取悦他们，外国使节向这些皇帝赠送了最精巧、最华丽的计时器。

ex.s: Now, after eight months of endless adjustments, the time has finally come for Mr Wang to wind up the gigantic clocks that date back to the time of Emperor Qianlong.
ex.t: 如今，经过八个月无休止的调校，王师傅终于等到了为那些可以追溯到乾隆年间 的巨大钟表上发条的时刻。
